about_the_game:
This is a DEMO version of The Last Fireman, with the first 5 levels.

🔥 Can you stop the fire before it's too late? 🔥

In The Last Fireman, the town is in danger, and only you can save it! Take on the role of a heroic firefighter in this fast-paced skill-based time attack game where every second counts. Race against the clock to extinguish the flames before they consume everything in their path!

🧯 How to Play

  • Grab your fire extinguisher and put out fires before time runs out!

  • Keep an eye on your extinguisher level—strategic refills are key!

  • Plan your route carefully and watch out—some objects may explode!

  • Conquer all levels and become the city's ultimate hero!

Do you have what it takes to stop the fire? 🔥🚒

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 550 TI / RX VEGA 8
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: The Last Fireman is a fast-paced time attack game where every second counts! Play as a heroic firefighter, race against the clock, and extinguish the flames before they consume the city. Plan your route, manage your extinguisher, and stop the fires on time! (This demo contains the first 5 levels)
